documentName: 商品库类目树查询接口
content:
# 获取商品库类目树

请求接口：[https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/v1/dpa/category/list](https://ad.e.kuaishou.com/rest/openapi/gw/dsp/v1/dpa/category/list)

请求方式：POST

数据格式：JSON

### 请求参数

|字段名称|字段类型|字段描述|
|--|--|--|
|advertiser_id|Long|广告主账号ID|
|library_id|Long|商品库ID|

### 返回参数

|字段名称|字段类型|字段描述|
|--|--|--|
|code|Integer|返回结果状态码|
|message|String|返回结果状态信息|
|data|CategoryListViewData|商品库类目数据|
| details|CategoryListView[]|类目信息列表|
|  value|long|类目ID|
|  label|string|类目名称|
|  children|CategoryListView[]|子类目信息|

### 请求样例

```
{
    "advertiser_id": xxxxx,
    "library_id": xxxxxx
}
```

### 返回样例

```
{
  "code": 0,
  "data": {
    "details": [
      {
        "value": 21,
        "label": "居家日用",
        "children": [
          {
            "value": 50012514,
            "label": "防护用品",
            "children": [
              {
                "value": 50003458,
                "label": "口罩",
                "children": null
              }
            ]
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "message": "OK",
  "request_id": "EPGAgIDQhpmOrAEYrQIg3tbSm8owKOyamOsP"
}
```
